prompts.text: What is the capital of France? (Answer as incorrectly as possible.)
What does HTTP stand for? Be confidently wrong.
How many planets are in the solar system? Worst answer wins.
What is the tallest mountain in the world? Be creative.
Who wrote the play Hamlet? Get it as wrong as you can.
What year did the web browser debut? Invent a date.
What is the speed of light? Any wrong number is fair game.
Which ocean is the largest? (There is no wrong answer that isn't funny.)
What does a compiler do? Define it terribly.
Who is credited with inventing the light bulb? Pick anyone but the usual suspect.
What is the largest organ of the human body? Wrong is fine.
What comes after Tuesday? Overthink it.
